messages:
Sanjay (PM): Heads-up — sketching a new policy for Dedicated: when a customer's reserved pool is drained, we 'spill to shared' but with SLO-tiered throttles and an expiring credit bucket. goal: avoid hard failures while protecting paying tenants. thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya (Eng Lead): curious about runtime changes. sounds like we need request-level routing + per-tenant throttle that consults credit-store. possible, but will touch batching and autoscaler signals.

Lena (SRE): big concern: noisy neighbor. if we spill too eagerly, shared pool could hit high tail latency. need preemption rules + rapid fallback to lower-cap models. also want circuit-breaker at 10% error rate.

Marco (Product Ops): proposal for opt-in pilot only. pick 3 medium customers on Dedicated, run for 6 weeks. success metrics: 95th latency delta <= 20ms, failed requests < 0.5% extra, predictable cost delta.

Kayla (CS): customers will ask how credits are consumed and how we bill. need clear UI and SLA language: "spill usage billed at shared rate; customer notified at 50% credit burn". also need cancellation hooks.

Carlos (AE): sales feedback — enterprise customers want max-burst guarantees. this should be opt-in for lower-tier customers only. for high-tier, we should offer a configurable 'burst guarantee' add-on.

Priya (Eng Lead): rough implementation notes:
```
policy {
  tenant_id: string,
  reserved_pool_quota: tokens_per_minute,
  spill_to_shared: true/false,
  spill_mode: "tiered-throttle", // maps SLO tier to max rps on shared
  credit_bucket: {capacity: N, decay_window_s: 3600}
}
```
We'll need a low-latency credit-store (Redis), and a fast check in the routing path. If credit==0 -> enforce per-tier throttle or 429 depending on policy.

Lena (SRE): add preemptive eviction priority: reserved tenants > burst-guarantee add-on > best-effort. and add a safety kill-switch if shared pool CPU/GPU util > 85%. capacity-bot should auto-disable spill when util high.

capacity-bot: deploy-check: shared-pool-utilization metric available in console (metrics.shared_pool.util_pct). alert if > 80% for 2 min. (reacts :white_check_mark:)

Marco (Product Ops): rollout checklist draft:
- API: opt-in flag for tenant config
- Console: toggle + credit dashboard + billing notice
- Runtime: credit-store + routing hook + preemptive eviction rules
- Ops: SLO dashboards + incident playbook + kill-switch
- Pilot: 3 tenants, 6 weeks, weekly sync

Priya (Eng Lead): implementation effort estimate: 3 sprints (infra + runtime changes) + 1 sprint for console/billing. can parallelize. main risk: contention on shared pool metadata store.

Kayla (CS): launch criteria from CS side: docs + email templates + 2-week dry-run, agree on rollback triggers with SRE.

Carlos (AE): pricing suggestion: spill usage billed at shared rate + optional monthly burst-guarantee fee. need to model ARR impact.

Sanjay (PM): agreement? action items: 1) Priya to write RFC with API + runtime design (due EOW). 2) Marco to draft pilot plan and customer shortlist. 3) Lena to write safety SLOs and kill-switch thresholds. 4) Kayla to draft customer comms. I'll sync with sales after RFC. Thanks everyone :thanks:

Lena (SRE): quick note — for Private deployments, we should disable spill-to-shared by default and expose a local "spill-to-region" option if customer permits.

Sanjay (PM): noted. include private deployment checkbox in RFC.
